profile.headline: Software Engineer II at AOE
profile.summary: Detail-oriented Software Engineer with experience in full-stack development and a background in Electrical & Computer Engineering. Proven track record of delivering scalable components, optimizing workflows, and collaborating in Agile environments. Passionate about building efficient, user-centric solutions.

positions.title: Software Engineer 2
positions.description:
- Owned modernization of legacy features, migrating menus from HTML/CSS/Javascript to TypeScript/React, improving user interaction by 15% (via Amplitude).

- Delivered 5+ major features in 2-week Agile sprints, including 10+ reusable React components adopted by 3+ teams to cut UI dev time by 20%.

- Led testing infrastructure, writing 50+ unit tests (Jest) and Storybook visual tests, boosting code coverage from 70% to 80%.

- Resolved 30+ long-standing bugs while contributing to concurrent projects per sprint, unblocking senior engineers on critical deadlines.
positions.insights: Python (Programming Language), Time Management and +5 skills

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.locationName: San Mateo, California, United States · Hybrid
positions.description:
- Cleared 30+ backlogged bugs (2+ years old), improving system stability for 1M+ monthly active users.

- Removed legacy code and deprecated features, reducing maintenance overhead by 15%.

-Supported major feature launches by writing unit tests and debugging production issues, achieving 95% sprint completion.
positions.insights: Python (Programming Language), Time Management and +5 skills

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description: Momentive, the maker of SurveyMonkey and GetFeedback, is an agile experience management company built for what’s next. We deliver intuitive, people-centric solutions that help industry leaders quickly and confidently make important decisions, take action, and achieve tangible results. We’re proud to work with decision-makers at 345,000 organizations globally. Learn more at  Momentive.ai .

positions.title: Marketing Intern
positions.description:
- Worked closely with product and operations teams to support various market research, content curation, and growth hacking projects.

- Designed and Implemented a Contact us page for the company

educations.schoolName: Duke University Pratt School of Engineering

honors.title: David M. Rubenstein Scholarship
honors.description: The David M. Rubenstein Scholars Program is designed to attract and support first-generation, low-income students financially, academically, personally, and professionally. It was named after David M. Rubenstein, the philanthropist and Duke alumnus who was the first member of his family to attend college.

honors.title: Goldberg Scholar
honors.description: The Dave Goldberg Scholars Program honors the remarkable life and legacy of Dave Goldberg by providing exceptional KIPP and Peninsula Bridge graduates with financial support, one-on-one mentorship, and internship opportunities throughout college
honors.issuer: Issued by Dave Goldberg Scholars Program · Aug 2018
